{{Conjecture|legends}}
The '''battle of Gosho IV''' occurred during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gosho IV]] at some point between [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] and [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. It was fought between the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and members of [[Churhee's Riflemen]]. The Imperials had the Riflemen pinned down and launched a salvo of [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] as a prelude to their assault. However, utilizing [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian]] [[R-TechApp Man Trap|man traps]], the grenades were forced to explode prematurely, neutralizing their effect. This blunted the Imperials' initiative, allowing the Riflemen to rally and push them back.
